contentList.content: Spit a great orb of flame that explodes on impact, scorching everything in its radius.
Shape chakra into a dragon of water that crashes into the target and drenches it.
Focus lightning chakra in your hand and dash through the target in an instant.
Take a deep breath and blast a gale of wind that pushes enemies back.
Raise sharp stone spears from the earth to impale your foes.
